results.name: Offline file launch: correct title, meaningful UI and 12 demo badges
Event name updates every sheet live
Pagination exposes the second six attendees and disables end controls
Three distinct designs render correctly and generate A4 demo PDFs
Print geometry: 90 × 80 mm, 6 mm gaps and all pages visible
Paste quoted CSV, Unicode, empty organization and default role
Import a CSV file and import the same file again
Import button opens a native file chooser
Malformed data clears stale badges and disables print
Empty and header-only lists show an empty state
Missing event name blocks printing and recovers on edit
HTML and script-like data are rendered as literal text
Maximum-length names, event, organization and role fit in all designs
Over-limit fields produce errors instead of truncated names
Oversized file preserves the current attendee list and explains the failure
1, 6, 7, 12 and 13 attendees paginate without extra sheets
1000-attendee limit renders 167 pages and rejects attendee 1001
Print button invokes browser printing with valid data
Browser print command flushes a pending edit before printing
Mobile and tablet layouts have no horizontal overflow
Keyboard radio navigation selects a design and shows focus
Reload restores demo and no attendee data is stored
No network requests, runtime errors, warnings or framework overlays
